# data.docker_image_history

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: data-source. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

Reads the layer history of a local image, like `docker image history` (`GET /images/{name}/history`). Entries come newest first, as the daemon returns them; each one is the instruction that created a layer.

## Arguments and attributes

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `content_sha256` | `string` | computed |  |  | sha256 of history_json. |
| `docker_server_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Docker Engine version from GET /version. |
| `engine_api_version` | `string` | computed |  |  | Engine API version negotiated with the daemon (min of the client maximum and GET /version ApiVersion). |
| `history` | `list(object)` | computed |  |  | The GET /images/{name}/history response as a nested object, field by field. |
| `history_json` | `string` | computed |  | yes | The exact Engine API GET /images/{name}/history response as JSON. |
| `id` | `string` | computed |  |  | ID of the image (the first history entry). |
| `name` | `string` | required |  |  | Image name, tag or ID, e.g. `nginx:1.27`. |
| `platform` | `string` | optional |  |  | Platform of a multi-platform image to read, `os[/arch[/variant]]`. Default: the daemon's platform. Needs API 1.48+ (containerd image store). |

### `history`

nested attribute, list(object). The GET /images/{name}/history response as a nested object, field by field.

| Name | Type | Status | Forces replacement | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `comment` | `string` | computed |  |  | Upstream `Comment`. |
| `created` | `number` | computed |  |  | Upstream `Created`. |
| `created_by` | `string` | computed |  | yes | Upstream `CreatedBy`. Sensitive. |
| `id` | `string` | computed |  |  | Upstream `Id`. |
| `size` | `number` | computed |  |  | Upstream `Size`. |
| `tags` | `list(string)` | computed |  |  | Upstream `Tags`. |

## Example

```terraform
# Layer history of a local image, newest layer first (docker image history).
data "docker_image_history" "nginx" {
  name = "nginx:1.27"
}

output "nginx_layers" {
  value = [for h in data.docker_image_history.nginx.history : h.created_by]
}
```
